verbosity_var.description: The variable name used for the verbosity configuration key in Perl hash.

hook_d.description: Path of the package manager hook scripts.

sendnotify.description: Disable sending notifications to user sessions.

has_pam_systemd.description: Set to false if using systemd without pam_systemd.so.

defno.description: Change default answer to 'no' in interactive mode.

systemctl_combine.description: Print a combined systemctl restart command line for skipped services.

perlcache.description: Use a persistent cache file of perl scanning results.

skip_mapfiles.description: Verify mapped files in filesystem: 0=enabled, -1=ignore non-existing (default), 1=disable check.

kernelhints.description: Enable/disable hints on pending kernel upgrades: 1=require ack, 0=disable, -1=stderr only.

kernelfilter.description: Filter kernel image filenames by regex. Required on Raspian.
